pr_title: Fix Find Next shortcut not working when search bar is focused
pr_body:
Fixes #52238 

I added a special case to CodeTextEditor::input. While it would be better to track down the exact propagation of the input, this fix is rather simple and just works.
pr_comments: This is not a regression, as the issue still occurs on Godot 3.3.

> This is not a regression, as the issue still occurs on Godot 3.3.

This will likely need a dedicated PR to be resolved in `3.x`.

### Godot version

W10

### Issue description

Title.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open any script in Script Editor
2. Select some word that has multiple occurrences
3. Press Ctrl + F
4. Press F3
5. No effect, editor doesn't go to the next word

_No response_

review_comments: Need to accept the event here and below.

> though it might be worth moving this to the `FindReplaceBar` itself so it's a little more self contained.

I've noticed that FindReplaceBar does not handle any shortcuts that might be relevant to it, instead they're handled by ScriptEditor and CodeTextEditor. I decided to keep to that convention, in case FindReplaceBar is used somewhere where shortcuts are not desired.
